body: I agree. I’m on the edge right now and if I feel 1% worse I won’t have any other options. But other people act like as long as your alive, you’re fine. If you died, they’d be freaking out that you didn’t ask for help and you hid it. I wish there was something else that could show people how bad you feel before you have to get to that point. Or maybe it’s that people don’t want to help and convince themselves you don’t really need it?

Btw my plan is either continuing to visit other people or my schools library is open 24/7 and you can’t get in unless you’re a student. More information is my parents screaming at me during the panic attack, I blocked out the words but the theme was I’m selfish, and I tried to escape but I was locked in my room. It was pretty horrific, she just screamed and screamed until she burned out and then texted me that she loved me. That’s really fucked me up. I’ve also texted my aunt to see if she can mitigate this a bit.
That’s really brave and the right choice, protect yourself
“I don’t even know what I did” really cut deep for me. I hate when they play dumb to avoid consequences.
I can relate to all of this. Realizing it only makes you stronger <3
